plain_english_explanation: This message claims an unverified package is awaiting delivery and redirects to a high-abuse disposable TLD domain designed to capture personal addresses and credit card details.
submitted_content: USPS Alert: Package delivery pending due to incorrect house number. Confirm your street address within 12 hours: https://delivery-tracking-portal.xyz/update

highlighted_quotes: Confirm your street address within 12 hours

why_dangerous.title: Untrusted TLD Destination
why_dangerous.description: Domain registered on .xyz commonly associated with bulk disposable spam campaigns.

recommended_actions: Do NOT click the SMS link.
Cross-reference the tracking code directly on the official postal website.
